title: A Survey on RLOps for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23357v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become increasingly important for improving the reasoning, instruction-following, and task-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, scaling RL training exposes failures in distributed execution, feedback computation, and learning dynamics that can waste computational resources, slow training, and undermine model improvements. These challenges have motivated a growing body of techniques for LLM RLOps, which manages the efficiency and reliability of operations throughout the LLM reinforcement learning training lifecycle. Despite growing interest, these techniques remain scattered across research areas, with limited synthesis of their operational roles and interactions. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic survey of LLM RLOps methods. We organize existing approaches into five stages: Training Setup, Experience Collection, Reward Computation, Policy Optimization, and Model Evalua

translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）在提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理、指令遵循和任务解决能力方面正变得越来越重要。然而，扩展强化学习训练会暴露出分布式执行、反馈计算和学习动态方面的故障，这些故障会浪费计算资源、拖慢训练速度并削弱模型改进效果。这些挑战催生了越来越多的大语言模型RLOps技术，用于管理大语言模型强化学习训练全生命周期的运行效率与可靠性。尽管关注度不断上升，这些技术仍然分散在各个研究领域，对其运维角色及相互作用的系统性梳理较为有限。为弥合这一差距，我们对大语言模型RLOps方法进行了系统性综述。我们将现有方法组织为五个阶段：训练设置、经验收集、奖励计算、策略优化和模型评估。
tldr: 本文对大语言模型RLOps方法进行了系统性综述，将现有技术归纳为训练设置、经验收集、奖励计算、策略优化和模型评估五个阶段，填补了该领域技术碎片化、缺乏统一梳理的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic survey of LLM RLOps methods, organizing existing techniques into five stages—Training Setup, Experience Collection, Reward Computation, Policy Optimization, and Model Evaluation—to bridge the gap of scattered techniques across research areas.
